rationale: Construction run for the active recovery-vbal Candidate. The harness builds two real Replica values (a recovering replica holding only a default record for instance (1,0), and a peer whose record for the same instance is COMMITTED with a real PUT command), wires SendMsg through per-peer buffers, and delivers the messages through the real Marshal/Unmarshal form into the real handlers. It then reports (a) what the recovering replica reports as its own VBallot in the self PrepareReply, and (b) whether the remote COMMITTED reply is adopted or the resolution restarts phase 1. A local clean-copy run already showed the expected shape (self VBallot = the new ballot 3 while the seed lb.ballot is -1; the remote COMMITTED reply at vbal 0 is skipped; the instance ends PREACCEPTED with a NOOP command and a PreAccept is emitted), but that run is construction knowledge only; this product asks the trusted runner to reproduce the same events in a clean copy so the observation can be retained and used for a formal check.
question: For instance (1,0), with a recovering replica 0 whose record is a default NONE record and a peer 1 whose record is COMMITTED at vbal 0 with a real command: what VBallot does the recovering replica report in its own PrepareReply, and does handlePrepareReply adopt the peer's COMMITTED (Seq, Deps, Command) or does it restart phase 1 with NOOP? Please report the observed lb.status, the instance Status after the resolution, the command that ends up stored locally, and which message the recovering replica emits next.
